requirements_summary: Primary: embeddings for search + reranking, then semantic doc search. Latency targets: <100ms for UI vector lookup (95th). Throughput: sustained 200-300 qps for small vector queries; nightly batch: ingest ~2M records within 4-6 hours. Vector DB: ops prefers pgvector (cost) but product wants a managed vector DB (Pinecone/Weaviate) for scale. Security: Okta SSO, SOC2, audit logs, KMS integration, US data residency. Must support bulk upsert API and incremental reindexing. Fallback policy: degrade to smaller dims or cached vectors if Dedicated capacity constrained.
poc_notes: POC plan: use Hosted API initially for speed to results; evaluate cost and per-embed latency
